name: Robot Cell Equipment
summary: Modular unit equipment centered around robots, flexibly configurable and integrable based on process requirements.
contentHtml:
Robot unit equipment is a modular automation device developed by TXAM for flexible production.

Working Principle

The equipment is centered around a six-axis robot, combined with various end-of-arm tools and auxiliary devices to form a modular unit. It can be flexibly configured according to different process requirements, enabling one machine to perform multiple tasks.

Technical Advantages

  • Modular design, flexible configuration
  • One machine for multiple uses, improving equipment utilization
  • Easy to integrate into existing production lines
  • Efficient and reliable, simple maintenance
